summary: Adapter enforces stateless TDD lifecycle with mandatory Skill input gate; preparation requires backend hidden state disabled, shell commands disabled, declared slice, and nonempty contract/validator hashes; stages must proceed RED observed failure (tests/docs only), GREEN passing production write set, REFACTOR passing declared production/tests/docs set; invalid transitions block with RMAP diagnostics; candidate is non-authoritative and authorizes nothing; resume rejects stale identities and failed/stale/superseded runs; stage bindings require capsule-attempt bundle v1, exactly one context/attempt per stage, matching plan/slice/run/attempt IDs, STAGE-RED/GREEN/REFACTOR IDs, empty authorizations; protocol persistence validates artifact keys, containment, no reparse points, immutable existing files, required ordered documents, and preserves listed observations; execute rejects existing run dirs, requires bundle/store pair, writes recovery-state v1 with hashes, lineage null, stages, and no authorizations.
